notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
Hello fellow players,

while analyzing some Let's Plays (thanks to Fumblkrusch) we encountered some bugs we didn't notice before. Therefore we just updated the client. Here's what we've changed:
[list]
 [*]Fixed a bug that won't let you exit a gravity zone when trying to walk out of it with a different gravity direction set.
 [*]Moving lights that are controlled by buttons will now remember their position when dying after a checkpoint or going into the menu.
 [*]Removed spikes in an anger and a depression level that seemed to be unnecessarily unfair.
[/list]
If you stumble upon any other strange things please let us know by posting into our community group.

Cheerio,
Trymops

EDIT: There seems to be a problem with the OSX version. We are doing our best to provide a fix! We are sorry for any inconvinience caused.

EDIT2: There's a new update available now that should run on alle operating systems with all the fixes listed above. We hope there are no further issues.

notes.title: Soundtrack Update
notes.notes: Good news to everyone who is already enjoying the In Between soundtrack or plans to enjoy it in the future! We added an extra song, as it was requested by our community. The soundtrack now features the music from our 2014 trailer.

notes.title: Major Update
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that the major update is now live. We did some heavy improvements which mostly cover the following:

[h1]Checkpoints[/h1]

We decided to add one checkpoint to most of the levels. They are located near the center of a level or behind hard to beat obstacles. This should reduce frustration which was a huge problem players experienced since they had to start over from the beginning when failing near the end of a level. However, we didn't want the game to be too easy as it wouldn't fit the topic of death.

[h1]Level Tweaking[/h1]

Together with the checkpoints we reworked some of the levels to hint at the intended solution. Examining Let's Plays, screenshots and reviews by players we found some strange solutions to levels which were really hard to execute. This led to even more frustrating moments. To improve the experience we pointed out important elements and removed some parts that simply felt unfair.

[h1]Bug Fixing[/h1]

Of course this update also includes some bug fixing. We encountered some problems with big spike blocks, boxes and gravity zones which should be gone forever!

As always feel free to send us your thoughts about the update and the game itself. We are looking forward to your feedback!

notes.title: In Between Release
notes.notes:
Dear followers,

I am happy to announce that In Between finally has its store page set up. We are just doing some minor bug fixing before the game is ready for release. The game will come out on friday, 21st August 2015. We are really looking forward to this and we hope, that you will enjoy In Between as much as we do.

Cheerio,

Stephan, gentlymad.
